controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour from its measured spectrum; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The colour of the star's measured spectrum (Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1)). The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,132 K and log g 4.11 (u1 0.393, u2 0.297): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.
